core_obligations: Case I (z off the diagonal): the derived restriction of K is zero, so K vanishes on an open neighbourhood; set Z(z) empty.
Case II (z on the diagonal): regular immersion plus Koszul lifting gives a flat family of regular immersions Z(z) with the prescribed special fibre.
Glue the Z(z) via property (2), shrink the base by properness, and conclude with the fibre-isomorphism lemma.
proof_roadmap: Handle the two pointwise cases, glue the local pieces using the compatibility property, then shrink twice to reach the global conclusion.
difficulty_reason: Two-case pointwise analysis with Koszul lifting, a gluing argument over infinitely many points, and a properness shrink; heavy geometric content.
